title: Medical Laboratory Observer: Labcorp's Dr. Leslie Saltzman on Hereditary Genetic Risk Testing
summary: In a Q&A with Medical Laboratory Observer, Dr. Leslie Saltzman, vice president of Consumer Health Solutions at Labcorp, discussed the Marker by Labcorp Genetic Health Panel and the role of hereditary genetic risk testing.
body_markdown:
In a Q&A with *Medical Laboratory Observer* , Dr. Leslie Saltzman, vice president of Consumer Health Solutions at Labcorp, discussed the Marker by Labcorp Genetic Health Panel and the role of hereditary genetic risk testing.


**Key takeaway:** Labcorp's Marker Genetic Health Panel helps consumers identify inherited variants linked to more than 100 medically actionable conditions, empowering informed conversations with their healthcare providers.


Research shows nearly one in six adults who undergo genetic testing discover a variant tied to a serious, actionable condition. Launched in August, the panel aims to close that awareness gap — especially for those with limited family health history, including adoptees.


"Marker by Labcorp helps consumers identify inherited genetic variants associated with more than 100 medically actionable health conditions," Saltzman said.


**Why it matters:** Consumer-accessible genetic screening complements traditional family history assessment, giving people with incomplete medical histories a pathway to earlier awareness and proactive care.


**Read the full article in**[Medical Laboratory Observer](https://www.mlo-online.com/molecular/genetic-testing/article/55408410/hereditary-genetic-risk-testing-a-qa-with-labcorps-dr-leslie-saltzman) **.**
